title: Angband3D — Official Gameplay Showcase & Veteran Guide

chapters.title: Act 3: Seamless Dual Reality & Classic Sizzle
Act 6: The Living Chronicle & Voiced Lorekeeper
Act 8: Universal Saves & Open Source Community

subtitles.speaker: Enceladus
subtitles.text: Deep in the forgotten vaults of Morgoth, ancient terror stirs!

subtitles.speaker: Enceladus
subtitles.text: Lightning wands cleave the gloom, blades clash against draconic scales...

subtitles.speaker: Enceladus
subtitles.text: And thirty years of legendary roguelike history are reborn in first-person 3D.

subtitles.speaker: Enceladus
subtitles.text: Welcome to Angband. Every journey begins under the stars of the town square.

subtitles.speaker: Enceladus
subtitles.text: Stock your pack at the armory, ready your spells, and plunge into the deep.

subtitles.speaker: Enceladus
subtitles.text: Rule number one for the veteran: looking around will not get you killed.

subtitles.speaker: Enceladus
subtitles.text: Camera yaw costs precisely zero turns.

subtitles.speaker: Enceladus
subtitles.text: Pan the darkness, inspect every corridor, scout the pillars—the world moves only when you take a step.

subtitles.speaker: Enceladus
subtitles.text: Miss your glyphs? Fear losing your classic overview? Press Tab.

subtitles.speaker: Enceladus
subtitles.text: Instantaneous, bit-for-bit Angband 4.2.6 CRT terminal mode.

subtitles.speaker: Enceladus
subtitles.text: Every dungeon tile, monster letter, and stat line is preserved. The 3D world and classic matrix are one and the same.

subtitles.speaker: Enceladus
subtitles.text: Step through the dungeon in ASCII, open your classic equipment menus with 'e'...

subtitles.speaker: Enceladus
subtitles.text: And return to 3D right where you stand. Seamless, uncompromising dual reality.

subtitles.speaker: Enceladus
subtitles.text: In first-person, corridors are narrow and corners are blind. Manage your torchlight...

subtitles.speaker: Enceladus
subtitles.text: And when the deep closes in, let your ranger's infravision pierce the dark to track lurking predators.

subtitles.speaker: Enceladus
subtitles.text: At twelve-hundred and fifty feet, the dragon vault opens!

subtitles.speaker: Enceladus
subtitles.text: Phase Door to break line of sight, unleash lightning wands to soften scales, and strike with Westernesse. Pure turn-based roguelike combat.

subtitles.speaker: Enceladus
subtitles.text: Every deed is penned in real time into the Living Chronicle. Consult the Voiced Lorekeeper for tactical secrets.

subtitles.speaker: Lorekeeper
subtitles.text: Fire resistance is vital against draconic breath.

subtitles.speaker: Lorekeeper
subtitles.text: Don a Ring of Fire Resistance or quaff a Potion of Resist Heat before entering open halls.

subtitles.speaker: Enceladus
subtitles.text: And the monsters of the deep hold secrets. Click any creature in the dungeon to parley with authentic characters.

subtitles.speaker: Young Red Dragon
subtitles.text: My scales are like iron, and my breath is flame! Fools dare challenge the brood of the deep.

subtitles.speaker: Young Red Dragon
subtitles.text: Flee, mortal, ere your bones join the embers of the vault!

subtitles.speaker: Enceladus
subtitles.text: Angband 3D is one-hundred percent free and open-source on GitHub, built for the community to explore, mod, and improve.

subtitles.speaker: Enceladus
subtitles.text: Export and load your savefiles universally across Web Browser, Windows PC, and Android APK.

subtitles.speaker: Enceladus
subtitles.text: The cloud chronicler is hosted on angband3d.com, with complete DIY instructions in the repo to plug in your own keys.

subtitles.speaker: Enceladus
subtitles.text: The descent awaits.
